items.lede: God of War Laufey's release date is being delayed to May 20th, 2027, developer Santa Monica Studio announced today. It was set to launch on PlayStation 5 on February 16th. items.title: God of War Laufey delayed until May

items.lede: Santa Monica Studio will use the extra time to push the game "to its fullest potential."
